$comment: Gate B DRAFT rule object for RF-RTS-001 — pending, NON-EXECUTABLE. Authored only from RF Clinical Rule Specification v1.2 §14.2 and the RF-RTS-001 inventory entry. Mixed-source PROHIBITION rule: cites both architecture references (V3.1 §§12, 14.2, 24) and evidence claims (QRF-013, QRF-029, QRF-031, QRF-032). Expresses the prohibition only: an individual's clearance cannot be based on date, time since injury, expected recovery time, cohort benchmark, median return time, or population-based date alone. Per §14.2, cohort medians, pooled means, and regression formulas may be explained as population context (evidence_record_only) but cannot determine an individual's readiness date — this dual role is recorded in decision_contract without changing the primary permitted_use. No date-only/time-only individual clearance, RTT, RTS, fixed return date, individual prognosis, progression schedule, dosage, exercise selection, or complete rehab plan; bypasses no capacity-to-demand-gap assessment, Simulation/readiness evidence, monitoring, next-day response, safety, or external restrictions. Not approved. Not wired into any runtime.

input_contract.$comment: Structural inputs taken verbatim-in-meaning from v1.2 §14.2. Time-based and population-based references are recorded only to mark what must not become individual clearance.

decision_contract.$comment: Date-only individual-clearance prohibition structure only. Time since injury, expected recovery time, cohort benchmarks, median return times, and population return-time studies must not determine an individual's readiness date or clearance. Dual role preserved: population context may be EXPLAINED (evidence_record_only) but never converted into individual clearance. No RTT, RTS, fixed return date, individual prognosis, progression, or dosage. Safety precedence preserved.

notes: Mixed normative source; normative strength PROHIBITION; permitted_use prohibited_autonomous_rule (primary). Architecture references preserved per source: V3.1 §§12, 14.2, 24 (recorded as V3.1-12, V3.1-14.2, V3.1-24). Evidence grade/role preserved per source: QRF-013 (I1), QRF-029 (D2; conditional Munich cohort context only), QRF-031 (I1), QRF-032 (C1) — population/context evidence only, never individual date-clearance authority. Per §14.2 behavior preserved exactly: an individual's clearance cannot be based on date, time since injury, expected recovery time, cohort benchmark, median return time, or population-based date alone; cohort medians, pooled means, and regression formulas may be EXPLAINED as population context but cannot determine an individual's readiness date. Dual permitted use preserved: prohibited_autonomous_rule for date-only clearance and evidence_record_only for cohort benchmarks — represented in decision_contract (population_context_dual_role) without changing the primary permitted_use. The rule creates no date-only/time-only individual clearance, no RTT, RTS, fixed return date, individual prognosis, progression schedule, dosage, exercise selection, or complete rehab plan, and bypasses no capacity-to-demand-gap assessment, Simulation/readiness evidence, monitoring, next-day response, safety, or external restrictions. Safety-state choice (read §14.2 exactly): §14.2 does NOT assign a closed V3.1 safety state, so safety_state_output is null and blocked_targets is empty, and the date-only-clearance prohibition is represented in decision_contract; no safety state was inferred by analogy. Aligns with v1.2 §17 case 12 (never a precise return date) and case 20 (cohort/sex-mismatched timelines not substituted). Readiness prohibition rule, not a safety rule. No readiness, return, or performance engine is authored here. Draft — approval_status remains pending.
